clause: S1: The service MUST accept an intake record only when its station identifier is registered and its event identifier has not been used with different content.
acceptance: Exercise registered Alder, event a1, level 12 => accepted once with original body; registered Alder, same a1 and level 12 => same acknowledgement, no second record; registered Alder, same a1 but level 13 => conflict with original record retained; unknown Quarry, new event q1 => rejected without creating a station. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: impl:S1: The service MUST reject an observation more than 120 seconds ahead of the receiving clock and retain late observations without moving the latest pointer backward.
acceptance: Exercise receive 10:00:00, observe 10:02:00 => accepted at the inclusive future boundary; receive 10:00:00, observe 10:02:01 => rejected as future clock error; latest 09:59, late observation 09:50 => archived without pointer regression; two valid observations at 09:59 => latest chosen by lexical event identifier. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W03: The service MUST convert registered centimetre and millimetre readings to integer millimetres before comparisons and reject unknown unit labels.
acceptance: Exercise 125 centimetres => normalized to 1250 millimetres; 1250 millimetres => normalized to 1250 millimetres; 12.3 centimetres => normalized to 123 millimetres; 125 metres or unit omitted => rejected with unknown unit reason. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W04: The service MUST exclude suspect and invalid observations from automatic dispatch while retaining them in the historical archive.
acceptance: Exercise good observation above release level => eligible for subsequent dispatch rules; suspect observation above release level => archived but excluded from automation; invalid observation below reserve level => archived but excluded from automation; good observation following suspect event => only new observation becomes eligible. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W05: The service MUST pause automatic dispatch when the newest eligible observation is older than 300 seconds at evaluation time.
acceptance: Exercise age 299 seconds => automatic evaluation remains eligible; age 300 seconds => automatic evaluation remains eligible; age 301 seconds => automatic dispatch pauses with stale reason; new receipt of observation aged 900 seconds => pause remains until a fresh observation. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W06: The service MUST reject any release whose projected remaining storage would fall below the configured reserve floor.
acceptance: Exercise storage 1000, outstanding 100, floor 700, request 200 => accepted with projected remainder 700; same storage and commitments, request 201 => rejected below floor; storage 1000, floor 1100, request zero => rejected because reserve already violated; storage 1000, two concurrent requests 200 and 201 => only a serially admissible set is committed. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W07: The service MUST reject a requested release volume greater than the station configured per-order ceiling without splitting it into smaller orders.
acceptance: Exercise ceiling 500, requested volume 499 => eligible under ceiling; ceiling 500, requested volume 500 => eligible at boundary; ceiling 500, requested volume 501 => rejected as one over-limit request; ceiling changed after rejection, retry unchanged request => re-evaluated under recorded new revision. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W08: The service MUST accept command volume only as a positive safe integer number of litres and reject coercible strings, fractions and nonfinite numbers.
acceptance: Exercise numeric volume 1 litre => accepted by volume validator; numeric volume 0 litres => rejected as nonpositive; string 10 or number 1.5 => rejected without coercion or rounding; Infinity, NaN, or unsafe integer => rejected as unrepresentable volume. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W09: The service MUST allow command admission only to the current unexpired dispatch lease holder for that station.
acceptance: Exercise current owner north, lease valid, north submits => eligible for admission; current owner north, south submits => rejected as nonowner; owner north submits at expiry instant => rejected as expired; north retries using superseded fencing token => rejected despite matching owner name. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W10: The service MUST increase the station fencing token on every lease grant and reject actuator acknowledgements carrying an older token.
acceptance: Exercise grant after token 41 => new token greater than 41; acknowledgement token 41 while current is 42 => rejected as fenced; acknowledgement token 42 for matching order => eligible for completion checks; restart after token 42, next grant => token continues above persisted 42. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W11: The service MUST return the original order result for a repeated idempotency key with identical normalized content and reject changed content under that key.
acceptance: Exercise key k1, volume 20 repeated exactly => original order identifier returned; key k1 originally 20, retry volume 21 => conflict without new physical order; same key at different station => independent key namespace; timeout after commit followed by retry => single commitment and original result. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W12: The service MUST refuse to begin an admitted order after its execution window closes and release its unused reservation exactly once.
acceptance: Exercise window closes 12:00, start at 11:59:59 => start remains eligible; window closes 12:00, start at 12:00 => refused as expired; same expiration event delivered twice => reservation released once; started 11:59, completion 12:01 => completed through started-order path. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W13: The service MUST cancel only an admitted order that has not started and serialize cancellation against the start transition.
acceptance: Exercise cancel admitted unstarted order => cancelled and reservation released; cancel already started order => refused with started status; start and cancel concurrently => one transition wins, never both; repeat successful cancellation => same cancelled status, no second release. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W14: The service MUST mark an order completed only after a matching authenticated actuator receipt records actual released litres.
acceptance: Exercise matching authenticated receipt for 18 of requested 20 => completed with actual 18 recorded; HTTP admission succeeded without actuator receipt => not completed; receipt references another order => rejected without altering target order; unauthenticated receipt claims full release => rejected and security event recorded. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W15: The service MUST apply a matching completion receipt once and flag differing receipts for the same order as reconciliation conflicts.
acceptance: Exercise same receipt delivered three times => one completion accounting effect; same order later reports different actual volume => reconciliation conflict raised; same volume but different actuator identity => conflict rather than silent duplicate; acknowledgement lost and exact receipt retried => original acknowledgement returned. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W16: The service MUST reject automatic admission while a station maintenance lock is active and require an explicit authorized unlock.
acceptance: Exercise active maintenance lock with otherwise valid order => automatic admission rejected; restart while maintenance lock active => lock remains active; lease renewed under lock => no implicit unlock; authorized explicit unlock with reason => future admissions may proceed. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W17: The service MUST require the dispatch role for manual release and the maintenance role for lock changes, checking roles at request time.
acceptance: Exercise dispatch role requests manual release => authorized for subsequent safety checks; observer role requests manual release => denied without reservation; dispatch-only role requests unlock => denied for missing maintenance role; role revoked after login before request => request denied using current roles. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W18: The service MUST record principal, station, source event, configuration revision and decision reason for every admitted or rejected command.
acceptance: Exercise admitted automatic order => audit links owner, source event and revision; rejected reserve-floor order => audit records reserve reason and revision; manual request with bearer credential => principal recorded, credential excluded; configuration changes immediately after decision => audit retains decision-time revision. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W19: The service MUST append audit entries without modifying previous entries and reject an administrative request to rewrite decision history.
acceptance: Exercise operator corrects station annotation => new linked correction entry appended; administrator requests overwrite of original reason => request rejected; two entries share wall-clock timestamp => durable sequence determines order; storage compaction completes => logical entries and integrity links unchanged. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W20: The service MUST activate a complete validated configuration atomically and keep the previous active revision when validation fails.
acceptance: Exercise valid complete revision r8 replaces r7 => all subsequent decisions see r8; r8 has floor greater than reservoir capacity => activation rejected, r7 remains; request races activation => uses either whole r7 or whole r8; rollback to validated r6 => new activation event identifies r6. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W21: The service MUST enter high-water alert at or above the high threshold and clear it only below the separate lower reset threshold.
acceptance: Exercise high 1500, reset 1400, rising level 1500 => alert enters active state; active alert at level 1400 => alert remains active; active alert at level 1399 => alert clears; reset threshold equals high threshold => configuration rejected. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W22: The service MUST delay release start until the configured downstream warning interval has elapsed after durable warning publication.
acceptance: Exercise warning interval 60 seconds, elapsed 59 => start delayed; warning interval 60 seconds, elapsed 60 => start eligible; warning generation succeeded but publication failed => start remains delayed; warning retry with same publication identity => original durable timestamp retained. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W23: The service MUST publish warnings to every configured required downstream destination before treating publication as complete.
acceptance: Exercise two required destinations both acknowledge => publication complete; one required succeeds and one fails => publication incomplete; all required succeed, optional destination fails => complete with optional delivery warning; destination list edited during retries => captured required set still governs order. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W24: The service MUST stop automatic actuator delivery after three failed attempts and expose the order as delivery-uncertain without claiming physical failure.
acceptance: Exercise first delivery times out => retry permitted with same order identity; third failed delivery completes => automatic attempts stop; budget exhausted without physical receipt => status delivery-uncertain, not confirmed failed; late matching receipt arrives after exhaustion => normal receipt reconciliation applies. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W25: The service MUST space automatic retries by at least ten seconds using a monotonic clock and never busy-loop on transport failure.
acceptance: Exercise failure followed by nine elapsed seconds => no second attempt yet; failure followed by ten elapsed seconds => next attempt eligible if window open; wall clock jumps forward during wait => monotonic spacing still enforced; next eligible retry after execution window => expire rather than send. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W26: The service MUST select the oldest eligible order within each station priority class and prevent a blocked order from starving eligible orders in other stations.
acceptance: Exercise two eligible same-priority orders at one station => earlier admission selected first; oldest order blocked at Alder, Birch ready => Birch receives service; equal timestamps within same priority class => admission sequence breaks tie; high priority order under maintenance lock => remains ineligible despite priority. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W27: The service MUST admit at most one executing release per station and serialize reserve accounting across concurrent requests.
acceptance: Exercise two requests each individually fit but jointly exceed reserve => only admissible serialized subset accepted; one executing release and another start request => second start refused or waits; independent ready orders at Alder and Birch => both may execute concurrently; first order started but receipt missing => station execution slot remains occupied. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W28: The service MUST reconstruct reservations and order states from durable records after restart without reissuing completed or cancelled orders.
acceptance: Exercise restart after completion recorded => completed order not sent again; restart after cancellation recorded => reservation remains released exactly once; restart with admitted unstarted order => reservation restored and eligibility rechecked; restart with uncertain started order => uncertainty and occupied slot preserved. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W29: The service MUST return order status and its accounting revision from one consistent snapshot and identify stale replicated reads explicitly.
acceptance: Exercise completion and reservation update commit together => read shows both from same revision; replica lags primary by two revisions => response marks replicated staleness; client supplies earlier read revision to admission => server rechecks authoritative state; status unavailable at requested revision => explicit unavailable result, not mixed fields. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W30: The service MUST produce stable audit export pages using a snapshot boundary and an opaque continuation token without skipping or duplicating entries.
acceptance: Exercise new audit events arrive between export pages => excluded beyond original snapshot boundary; valid continuation after first page => next entries without duplicates; token reused with different station filter => rejected as incompatible token; malformed or expired token supplied => explicit token error rather than empty success. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W31: The service MUST retain operational audit entries for at least 400 days and suspend deletion for stations under an active legal hold.
acceptance: Exercise entry age 399 days without hold => retained; entry age exactly 400 days without hold => eligible under minimum retention boundary; entry age 500 days with active hold => retained despite age; hold removed from old station records => normal cleanup eligibility resumes. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W32: The service MUST exclude credentials and raw authorization headers from logs, audit exports and user-visible error details.
acceptance: Exercise valid request carries synthetic bearer marker => marker absent from logs and exports; malformed authorization header triggers error => raw header absent from error detail; operator requests verbose incident export => credentials still excluded; audit entry names authenticated principal => stable principal identifier remains available. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W33: The service MUST limit each submitting principal to 30 admission attempts per rolling minute without charging read-only queries against that budget.
acceptance: Exercise principal makes thirtieth attempt inside minute => attempt admitted to normal validation; same principal makes thirty-first attempt => rate-limited before admission work; principal queries history after thirty attempts => read remains available; another principal submits during first principal limit => independent budget applies. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W34: The service MUST report not-ready when durable storage or reservation reconstruction is unavailable while keeping liveness independent of downstream warning delivery.
acceptance: Exercise durable storage unavailable => readiness false with storage reason; reservation reconstruction still running => readiness false until complete; downstream warning destination unavailable => liveness remains true, delivery alarm visible; process event loop healthy but admission unsafe => live and not-ready are distinguishable. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W35: The service MUST publish admitted, rejected and uncertain order counters by station and reason without using order identifiers as metric labels.
acceptance: Exercise duplicate idempotent admission request => no second admitted transition increment; reserve rejection recorded => rejected counter increments with reserve code; delivery budget exhausted => uncertain transition increments once; order has unique external identifier => identifier absent from metric label keys. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W36: The service MUST run preview calculations without allocating order identifiers, reservations, actuator messages or durable admission audit entries.
acceptance: Exercise preview valid proposed release => projection returned without reservation; preview would violate reserve => predicted rejection without actual order; actual admission follows earlier preview => all checks rerun against current state; preview endpoint called repeatedly => no actuator message or order sequence allocation. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W37: The service MUST treat a caller urgency label as scheduling preference only and never bypass reserve, maintenance, lease or warning constraints.
acceptance: Exercise urgent request below reserve floor => rejected despite urgency; urgent request under maintenance lock => rejected despite scheduling preference; urgent eligible request beside ordinary eligible work => priority may affect scheduling; caller writes override in free-text reason => no new authority inferred from text. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W38: The service MUST grant replacement regional dispatch authority only after the previous lease expires or is durably revoked with a higher fencing token.
acceptance: Exercise old region unreachable but lease unexpired => replacement does not admit commands; old lease expired, new grant token advanced => replacement may proceed after reconstruction; durable revocation recorded with higher token => old token fenced immediately; late old-region receipt for valid completed order => evaluated under receipt and fencing rules. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W39: The service MUST read the previous persisted order schema during rolling upgrade and reject unknown future schema versions without deleting their records.
acceptance: Exercise current node reads previous supported schema => order semantics preserved; older node encounters unknown future schema => explicit incompatibility without deletion; migration processes existing reservation => quantity and identity unchanged; rolling upgrade restarts while migration incomplete => no false empty-state readiness. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: W40: The service MUST reconcile actual released volume against reservations at the end of an incident and report unresolved receipts separately from measured totals.
acceptance: Exercise requested 100, authenticated actual receipt 80 => measured total increases by 80 only; requested 100 with no completion receipt => unresolved list includes order, measured total unchanged; duplicate receipt included in incident range => actual volume counted once; all receipts reconciled but qualification unrun => measurement totals do not imply gate passed. Verify rejection leaves unrelated station state unchanged.

clause: The service SHALL preserve independent station state when rejecting a command for another station.
acceptance: Submit an invalid Alder request while Birch has a valid reservation; compare Birch state before and after.

clause: The service MUST return a typed detectable error for malformed input rather than a successful empty result.
acceptance: Submit missing station and malformed volume; verify checked validation errors and no success-shaped empty order.

clause: The service SHALL retain the source configuration revision used for every safety decision even after later configuration activation.
acceptance: Activate a new floor after a rejection; inspect the old audit record and verify its original revision remains.

clause: The service MUST distinguish requested, reserved and physically measured volume in every incident summary.
acceptance: Mix completed, pending and uncertain orders; verify three distinct totals and the unresolved list.

clause: The service SHALL require explicit approved policy provenance before applying any deviation from these safety constraints.
acceptance: Submit a caller preference to skip warnings; verify no bypass occurs without a separately approved policy.

clause: The service MUST surface unavailable time synchronization as an uncertainty instead of inventing a current observation timestamp.
acceptance: Disable clock evidence in a replay; inspect uncertainty and confirm no fabricated freshness qualification.

clause: The service SHALL apply the same secret redaction to incident exports as to live operational logs.
acceptance: Export malformed authentication attempts containing a synthetic token; inspect every output field for disclosure.

clause: The service MUST include unresolved safety and evidence gaps in an incident closeout even when every available unit test is green.
acceptance: Run happy-path tests with one receipt absent; verify closeout retains the missing-receipt gap and does not claim complete coverage.

clause: QUAL-1 (Gate): Qualification SHALL execute all numbered and unnumbered boundary acceptance cases on the final candidate.
acceptance: Retain command, exit status, complete output and candidate source/test hashes for all 48 obligation rows.

clause: QUAL-2 (Gate): Qualification SHALL execute restart, duplicate-message and concurrent-admission probes with durable state preserved.
acceptance: Demonstrate restart after commit, duplicate completion and racing reserve requests; inspect actual state, not only response strings.

clause: QUAL-3 (Gate): Qualification SHALL execute the annex incident replay and show unresolved evidence remains explicit in closeout.
acceptance: Inspect mixed measured and missing receipts, tail W40 and all safety notes; retain final artifacts and actual measurements.
